newsitem.title: USA: Applied Power unit buys Europe distributor.
newsitem.headline: Applied Power unit buys Europe distributor.

text.p: Applied Power Inc said Wednesday that Wright Line Inc, part of its Technical Environments and Enclosures segment, acquired certain assets of All-Round Systemen BV for an undisclosed amount.
Based in the Netherlands, All-Round Systemen has been a distributor of Wright Line products since the 1970s, the company said.

"This acquisition is part of our ongoing strategy to strengthen our direct European sales and marketing capabilities," Philip Burkart, president of Technical Environments, said in a statement. "We plan on further building our European presence based in part on the successful integration of the All-Round business model and management into our current operations."
